PR Summary by Qodo

Add unattended lead monitoring, handoff, reconciliation, and budgets ✨ Enhancement 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Detect stalled leads without treating handoffs or routine state writes as progress.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD P["Playbook"] --> W["Watchdog"] --> G["GitHub room"] --> R["Reconcile"] --> L["Lead CLI"] --> S[("State branch")] S --> W A["GitHub activity"] --> W A --> R P --> L L --> G ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Webhook-driven monitoring
- ➕ Could detect progress and stalls more promptly without repeatedly querying GitHub. - ➖ Requires a persistent receiver, event storage, deployment, and failure recovery outside the existing scheduled-task model.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the scheduled, read-only watchdog: it fits the existing GitHub-backed state and task model without adding a service. Review its progress and alarm rules carefully because those determine whether unattended failures reach the owner.

>Simulate pull-request listings and commit timestamps > >

>
> >tests/fake_gh_state.py

>Verify ROOM_TRUST retains the authenticated login > >
>• Checks that comments from both the authenticated login and an added alternate login remain trusted.
>
> >tests/test_room.py
test_state.pyCover new state fields and safe stale-worktree recovery +32/-11
>Cover new state fields and safe stale-worktree recovery > >
>• Checks the expanded machine block and verifies that moved-aside linked worktrees lose their .git links without affecting rebuilt worktrees. Adapts damaged-block fixtures to the expanded template.

>Exercise unattended commands and failure drills > >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
